easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Hedron Detonator triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Hedron Detonator is a Pirate due to Stalactite Dagger, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Hedron Detonator triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Hedron Detonator trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.
